name: Street Justice

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Your allies have Advantage on attacks against creatures you have Grappled. Add Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or break Chain, Manacles, or Rope you use to restrain a creature. Hostility does not give Disadvantage to your Intimidation checks to influence a creature.

benefits.name: Headlock
benefits.summary: Your allies have Advantage on attacks against creatures you have Grappled.
benefits.text: Your allies have Advantage on attacks against creatures you have Grappled.

benefits.name: Sturdy Knot
benefits.summary: Add Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or break Chain, Manacles, or Rope you use to restrain a creature.
benefits.text: When you use Chain, Manacles or Rope to restrain a creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the DC to escape or break it. The game doesn't bind captives yet, so this is played at the table.

benefits.name: Tough Talk
benefits.summary: Hostility does not give Disadvantage to your Intimidation checks to influence a creature.
benefits.text: Being hostile doesn't give you Disadvantage on Intimidation checks to influence a creature. The game has no influence checks yet, so this is played at the table.
